text: 【外国企业对特定动态随机存取存储器设备及其下游产品和组件（III）提起337调查申请】据中国贸易救济信息网消息，2026年8月11日，美国Netlist,Inc根据《美国1930年关税法》第337节规定向美国国际贸易委员会提出申请，主张对美出口、在美进口及销售的特定动态随机存取存储器（DRAM）设备及其下游产品和组件（III）违反了美国337条款。
text_en: Foreign Company Files Section 337 Investigation Application on Certain DRAM Devices and Their Downstream Products and Components (III): According to the China Trade Remedy Information Network, on August 11, 2026, Netlist, Inc. of the US filed a petition with the US International Trade Commission under Section 337 of the US Tariff Act of 1930, alleging that certain dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) devices and their downstream products and components (III) exported to, imported into, or sold in the US violate Section 337.
